turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Where is Owen's zero coming from?
Before we start, I reread Owen's last three essays this morning.
Okay. What did they show, Hale? I'm writing down whatever you say.
He writes like someone who was read to every night. That was you, wasn't it?
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked what those three essays showed about the zero, and I'm still waiting for an answer.
You've raised a genuinely thoughtful kid. I mean that.
Then why is there a zero in the gradebook? Withdraw it, Hale.
Which is why I'd hate for this to become a fight between two people who obviously both care about him.
It's only a fight if the zero stays. On what basis did you enter it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
